decisive_items: pedunculated bony protrusion arising from the posterolateral plantar aspect of the calcaneus
Magnetic resonance imaging of the left foot showed no thickening of the plantar fascia
response.rationale: Haglund syndrome is more likely due to the presence of a bony protrusion on the calcaneus, whereas plantar fasciitis is less likely due to the lack of thickening of the plantar fascia on MRI

rejected.why: Gastrocnemius tightness may be a contributing factor, but it is not the primary cause of the heel pain
